name: Can I repair an under-sink leak myself, or should I call a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I repair an under-sink leak myself, or should I call a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: Simple leaks, such as a loose nut on a drainpipe, might be tightened by a homeowner. However, more complex issues like corroded pipes, damaged P-traps, or problems with a garbage disposal often require professional expertise. Attempting a DIY fix without proper knowledge or tools can worsen the damage, leading to more expensive repairs down the line. A professional plumber from CG Plumbing Solutions can accurately diagnose the problem, ensure a durable repair, and prevent future issues. Deciding to call a professional often depends on your comfort level with plumbing tasks and the complexity of the leak.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor leaks may be DIY, but complex issues like corroded pipes or garbage disposal problems usually require a professional plumber to prevent further damage.
